title: Triple Pendulum on a Cart
summary: A TU Wien control-systems demo in which a triple pendulum on a cart is swung up and stabilized using constrained feedforward plus optimal feedback control. It accompanies a 2013 Automatica paper.
why: HN commenters cite it as an example of a hard, chaotic control problem that fast feedback and good control design can solve.

quote.text: Triple!!! inverted pendulum balancing with a physical cart (2011), a much much much harder task
